Stat

Stat components surface key metrics — label, value, and optional change indicator, icon, or sparkline.

Basic Stat

Use .zak-stat with .zak-stat-label and .zak-stat-value.

Total revenue
$48,920
Active users
8,240
Conversion
3.4%
HTML
<div class="zak-stat">
  <div class="zak-stat-label">Total revenue</div>
  <div class="zak-stat-value">$48,920</div>
</div>

Stat with Icon

Place an icon on the trailing edge for scannable dashboards.

New orders
1,284
Refunds
32
Pending reviews
7
HTML
<div class="zak-stat">
  <div class="zak-stat-label">New orders</div>
  <div class="zak-stat-value zak-stat-value-primary">
    <span>1,284</span>
    <svg class="zak-icon">...</svg>
  </div>
</div>

Trend Indicators

Show a change vs the previous period with .zak-stat-change plus zak-stat-change-up/zak-stat-change-down.

MRR
$12,400
↑ 12.4% vs last month
Bounce rate
34.2%
↓ 2.1% vs last month
Avg. session
4m 32s
↑ 18s vs last week
HTML
<div class="zak-stat">
  <div class="zak-stat-label">MRR</div>
  <div class="zak-stat-value">$12,400</div>
  <div class="zak-stat-change zak-stat-change-up">↑ 12.4% vs last month</div>
</div>

<!-- Negative trend -->
<div class="zak-stat-change zak-stat-change-down">↓ 2.1% vs last month</div>

Card Variants

Embed stats in cards with horizontal and colored accent styles.

Sessions
102,930
↑ 8.2%
Signups
3,408
↑ 24%
Avg. rating
4.8
HTML
<div class="zak-card" style="padding: var(--zak-space-5);">
  <div class="zak-stat">
    <div class="zak-stat-label">Sessions</div>
    <div class="zak-stat-value">102,930</div>
    <div class="zak-stat-change zak-stat-change-up">↑ 8.2%</div>
  </div>
</div>

Sparkline

Pair a value with an inline SVG mini-chart as a visual trend.

Page views
1.2M
↑ 15.8%
Support tickets
214
↓ 9.3%
Net revenue
$96,120
↑ 21.4%
HTML
<div class="zak-stat">
  <div class="zak-stat-label">Page views</div>
  <div class="zak-stat-value">1.2M</div>
  <div class="zak-stat-change zak-stat-change-up">↑ 15.8%</div>
  <svg viewBox="0 0 120 40" aria-hidden="true">
    <polyline points="0,32 ... 120,8" fill="none"
      stroke="var(--zak-color-primary)" stroke-width="2"/>
  </svg>
</div>

HTML
<div class="zak-card" style="padding: var(--zak-space-5);">
  <div class="zak-grid zak-grid-cols-3">
    <div class="zak-stat">
      <div class="zak-stat-label">Churn</div>
      <div class="zak-stat-value zak-stat-value-success">1.8%</div>

CSS Classes Reference

Class Description
.zak-statContainer for a metric block
.zak-stat-labelMuted label above the value
.zak-stat-valuePrimary metric display
.zak-stat-value-primaryTinted value (success/danger/warning also exist)
.zak-stat-changeChange vs previous period
.zak-stat-change-upPositive trend highlight
.zak-stat-change-downNegative trend highlight
.zak-stat-helpHelper/context line below the value
.zak-grid .zak-grid-cols-3Responsive stat grid

Accessibility

  • Each stat needs a visible label; use aria-label if the visual label is icon-only.
  • Never convey the change direction by color alone — keep the ↑/↓ arrows in the markup.
  • Sparklines are decorative: add aria-hidden="true" and rely on the numeric value for meaning.
  • Order stats to match their source data when used inside a table-like band.
  • Use native number formatting (e.g. Intl.NumberFormat) rather than hard-coded commas where possible.
